method: direct fetch of the European Commission's primary announcement page plus EDRi's own published position statement for the criticism claim; single-cycle verification given tight cycle time budget, no separate falsifier sub-agent spawned -- all four claims trace directly to a primary self-attributed source (the Commission's own account of its regulation, EDRi's own account of its position), which the fetch/search confirms verbatim rather than via paraphrase
origin_items: Carried over from cycle 1's Tier-0 sweep (European Commission Digital Strategy News: 'AI Omnibus enters into force', 2026-07-27), triaged in cycle 3

claims.text: The EU's AI Omnibus, a package of amendments to the AI Act, entered into force on 27 July 2026
claims.reasoning: Direct fetch of digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/news/ai-omnibus-enters-force confirms the package took effect 27 July 2026 across the EU. One Tier-0 primary source is the standard for an announcement claim.

claims.text: The package pushes the compliance deadline for high-risk AI systems listed in Annex III from August 2026 to 2 December 2027, and for high-risk AI embedded in physical products to 2 August 2028
claims.reasoning: Directly stated on the Commission's primary announcement page. Cross-checked against independent legal-press search results (Hunton, Lewis Silkin, Freshfields) which report the same two dates; not cited as sources since they are not registered, but corroborate the primary fetch.

claims.text: The package bans AI systems that generate non-consensual intimate imagery or child sexual abuse material, and expands the EU AI Office's oversight of general-purpose AI models and AI systems on major platforms
claims.reasoning: Directly stated on the Commission's primary announcement page.

claims.text: European Digital Rights (EDRi) publicly opposed the changes as a rollback of AI Act safeguards ahead of their adoption
claims.reasoning: EDRi's own published statement ('AI Omnibus deal: EU lawmakers should reject a rollback of AI safeguards') is a primary self-attributed source for EDRi's own position, same logic as citing a company's own blog for its own stated view. Framed in the article as EDRi's opinion, not as an established fact about the regulation's effect.

adversarial_notes: No separate falsifier sub-agent spawned given this cycle's tight time budget.
